subsystems.name: Antimatter production
subsystems.role: makes antiprotons in the first place, which is the fundamental bottleneck.

subsystems.name: Antimatter storage
subsystems.role: holds antiprotons (or antihydrogen) without letting them touch matter.

subsystems.name: Fuel pellet
subsystems.role: the target that antiprotons are injected into so annihilation energy is turned into useful products.

subsystems.name: Injection and ignition system
subsystems.role: delivers a controlled number of antiprotons at the right moment.

subsystems.name: Reaction chamber and nozzle
subsystems.role: contains the bursts and aims the charged debris into a directed exhaust.

subsystems.name: Spacecraft and thermal system
subsystems.role: turns pulsed thrust into a mission.

subsystems.name: Ground-based production infrastructure
subsystems.role: the accelerators, power supply and handling that could never fit on the ship.
parts: accelerator complex and its power supply

buildSteps.title: Make protons and hit a target
buildSteps.detail: A high-energy proton beam strikes a dense metal target; collisions spray out antiprotons among many other particles.

buildSteps.title: Capture what comes out
buildSteps.detail: Magnetic lenses focus the antiprotons into a storage ring, where the vast majority are lost before they can be trapped.

buildSteps.title: Cool and slow them
buildSteps.detail: Stochastic, electron and laser cooling plus deceleration bring a small surviving fraction to low energy in a trap.

buildSteps.title: Store without touching
buildSteps.detail: Electric and magnetic fields hold the particles in vacuum; for antihydrogen, combining antiprotons with positrons and trapping the neutral atoms is far harder.

buildSteps.title: Accumulate a usable quantity
buildSteps.detail: A spacecraft-scale design would need grams — billions of billions of times more than any facility has ever accumulated — so accumulation would have to be scaled up by an enormous factor.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the pellet
buildSteps.detail: A small core of fusion or fissile fuel is encased in a shell designed to absorb annihilation products and compress the core.

buildSteps.title: Inject and annihilate
buildSteps.detail: A metered burst of antiprotons is fired into the pellet; annihilation releases pions and gamma rays that drive compression and a micro-explosion.

buildSteps.title: Direct the exhaust
buildSteps.detail: A magnetic nozzle channels charged pions and plasma rearwards to produce thrust, while shielding absorbs the neutron and gamma flux.

buildSteps.title: Close the loop
buildSteps.detail: Pellets are fed at a pulse rate set by thrust needs, and the chamber and nozzle are kept cool enough to survive repeated bursts.

prerequisites.why: facilities such as CERN currently produce nanograms at most over whole campaigns; the energy spent to make antiprotons vastly exceeds the energy released by annihilating them.
research traps have held small numbers of antiprotons and antihydrogen for minutes to hours, but nothing remotely close to the quantities needed.
injection of antiprotons into fuel pellets has been studied on paper as a way to amplify the energy, but not demonstrated.
nozzles that convert hot plasma into directed thrust have been studied for fusion concepts generally, but never with annihilation products.
annihilation prodges hard gamma and neutron radiation that would demand heavy absorber mass.

pathway.milestone: antiprotons routinely produced, trapped and studied in the tiny quantities needed for physics
pathway.unlocks: measurement of antimatter properties; no propulsion relevance yet.

pathway.milestone: orders-of-magnitude cheaper antiproton production (accelerator and target efficiency)
pathway.unlocks: the idea moves from thought experiment to something that can be experimentally sized.

pathway.milestone: laboratory demonstration that annihilation products can ignite a small fuel pellet and produce net energy
pathway.unlocks: a measurable energy gain, the minimum for any engine.

pathway.milestone: an integrated pulsed engine test in vacuum
pathway.unlocks: a thrust and specific-impulse baseline for mission design.
only if antimatter can be made and stored at a scale no facility approaches today; otherwise this route stays theoretical.
